# BetterEveryday

> BetterEveryday is an AI-powered family wellness app that turns Fitness, Diet, and Learning into one daily habit loop. Families log their day in about 15 seconds, get a daily score and encouragement from an AI Coach, and build streaks together. The app is coming soon to iOS and Android.

## Who it is for

- Families with children who want to build healthy routines together
- Health-conscious adults who want to track their own reading, fitness, and diet

## How it works

1. Start a family team — invite everyone with a code, a link, or a QR scan.
2. Log your day in about 15 seconds — with a timer, a photo, or your voice — across Fitness, Diet, and Learning.
3. Get your AI Coach score — the AI Coach scores your day based on what you actually logged and suggests one next step.
4. Build streaks as a family — a shared family streak wall, plus optional leaderboards.

## The three pillars

- [Fitness](https://app.bettereveryday.live/fitness): live workout timer, GPS for outdoor runs, multiple exercises per session, and one tap to repeat your last workout.
- [Diet](https://app.bettereveryday.live/diet): snap a photo of a meal and AI logs the calories and macros automatically, or just say what you ate.
- [Learning](https://app.bettereveryday.live/learning): books, podcasts, and articles in one shared family timer and library; every session is scored by the AI Coach.

## Privacy and safety

- Kids' accounts come with parental controls.
- BetterEveryday never sells your family's data.
- Family and friend leaderboards are kept separate; competing with friends is opt-in and never on by default.
- The full Privacy Policy and Data & AI Principles will be published before launch.
